task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build the graph state for the graph [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3), (3, 4)] in Qiskit (H on all, CZ per edge) and verify every stabilizer K_v = X_v prod_{u in N(v)} Z_u has expectation +1 using StatevectorEstimator. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
